title: IncidentEvent
description: A grouping of one or more alerts that an analyst (or a triage process) has escalated into a tracked incident. Incidents are largely created inside AIRKit rather than ingested wholesale from a source, though a source's native case-management system (e.g. a Splunk notable event promoted to an investigation) may originate one via an adapter.

uid.description: Unique incident ID. If sourced from a vendor case system, prefixed with adapter name; if created natively in AIRKit, a generated ULID.

updated_time.description: Last time status or linked alerts changed.

linked_alert_uids.description: uid values from alert.schema.json events grouped under this incident.

affected_hosts.description: Hostnames or IPs identified as in-scope for this incident.

source.description: Omit entirely if this incident was declared natively inside AIRKit rather than ingested.

notes.description: Free-text analyst notes / running commentary. Kept here rather than forcing a separate comments store for the POC.
